ei.title: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass...
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. This makes it hard for them to stand comfortably upright for any length of time. In dinosaurs, by contrast, the centre of mass was over the hips. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a fulcrum, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs without effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or climbing.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② hardly → hard: make it hard에서 hard는 목적격 보어(형용사). hardly는 '거의 ~않다'라는 부사
det.analysis:
✅ ① upwards: lever themselves upwards — 부사, 적절
❌ ② hardly → hard: This makes it ___ for them to stand... make + it(가목적어) + 형용사(보어) + to부정사 구문. hard(어려운)가 필요. hardly는 '거의 ~않다'로 의미 전혀 다름 ←정답
✅ ③ counterbalanced: was counterbalanced by — be + p.p. 수동태, 적절
✅ ④ required: no longer required for running — 과거분사 수식, 적절
det.tip: make it + 형용사 + to부정사: hard(어려운) ≠ hardly(거의 ~않다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ slenderly → slender: be + 형용사 보어. slenderly라는 부사는 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① habitually: habitually four-footed creatures — 부사(형용사 수식), 적절
✅ ② stiff: a long, stiff tail — 형용사(명사 수식), 적절
❌ ③ slenderly → slender: they are more ___ towards the ends — be동사 뒤 보어 자리이므로 형용사 slender가 필요. slenderly(부사)는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ grasping: such as grasping prey items — 동명사, 적절

det.korean: ④ the easier is it → the easier it is: 'the 비교급 + S + V' 구문에서 주어+동사 어순 유지
det.analysis:

✅ ② themselves: lever themselves upwards — 재귀대명사(주어=목적어), 적절
✅ ③ could: dinosaurs could stand — 과거 조동사, 적절
❌ ④ the easier is it → the easier it is: 'The 비교급 S V, the 비교급 S V' 구문에서 도치 없이 S+V 어순. the easier it is to run fast가 정답 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① levering → to lever: It takes energy for them to lever — 가주어/진주어 구문에서 to부정사 필수
det.analysis:
❌ ① levering → to lever: It takes a lot of energy for them ___ themselves upwards — 가주어 It + takes + for + 목적격 + to부정사 구문. to lever가 필수. levering(동명사)은 이 구문에 부적절 ←정답
✅ ② comfortably: stand comfortably upright — 부사(동사 수식), 적절
✅ ③ relatively: A relatively short body — 부사(형용사 수식), 적절
✅ ④ reduced: were reduced — be + p.p. 수동태, 적절
det.tip: It takes + 비용 + for A + to V: 가주어/진주어 구문은 to부정사

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② unbalanced(불균형한) → counterbalanced(균형을 이룬): 짧은 몸체가 긴 꼬리에 의해 '균형을 이루었다'는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① energy: It takes a lot of energy — 네 발 동물이 뒷다리로 서려면 많은 '에너지'가 필요하다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② unbalanced → counterbalanced: A relatively short body ... was ___ by a long, stiff tail — 짧은 몸이 긴 꼬리에 의해 '균형을 이루었다'는 뜻. unbalanced(불균형한)는 정반대 의미 ←정답
✅ ③ slender: they are more slender towards the ends — 다리 끝이 '가는' 것이 움직이기 쉽다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ free: the hands left free for other activities — 손이 다른 활동을 위해 '자유로운' 상태라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: counterbalanced(균형을 이룬) ↔ unbalanced(불균형한)

questions.passage: Most habitually four-footed creatures have a centre of mass in the chest region. It takes a lot of energy for them to lever themselves upwards onto their hindlimbs. A relatively short body forward of the hips was counterbalanced by a long, stiff tail behind. With the hips as a ②<u>fulcrum</u>, dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs ③<u>with</u> effort. Rather than the short, thick limbs of most amniotes, dinosaurs could grow their hindlimbs long and thin. Legs are easier to move if they are more slender towards the ends. The easier the legs are to move, the easier it is to run fast. The arms, no longer required for running, were reduced, the hands left free for other activities, such as grasping prey items or ④<u>climbing</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ with(~을 가지고) → without(~없이): 공룡은 뒷다리로 '힘들이지 않고(without effort)' 설 수 있었다는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① upright: stand comfortably upright — '똑바로' 서다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② fulcrum: With the hips as a fulcrum — 엉덩이가 '지렛대 받침점' 역할을 한다는 비유에 적절
❌ ③ with → without: dinosaurs could stand on their hindlimbs ___ effort — 앞 문맥에서 네 발 동물은 에너지가 많이 든다고 했고, 공룡은 대조적(by contrast)으로 '힘 안 들이고' 선다는 의미. with effort는 반대 ←정답
✅ ④ climbing: such as grasping prey items or climbing — '등반'은 자유로운 손으로 할 수 있는 활동으로 적절
det.tip: without effort(힘들이지 않고) ↔ with effort(힘들여)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: over the hips(엉덩이 위): 공룡의 질량 중심이 '엉덩이 위'에 있었다는 핵심 정보
